title: Trace State Park fall festival set for Oct. 24, with entrance fees waived
excerpt: Trace State Park’s Oct. 24 festival runs 4–7 p.m. with trick-or-treating, games, hayrides and campsite decorating. Entrance fees are waived for the event.
locality: Trace State Park, Belden, Mississippi, serving the Pontotoc area.

paragraphs.text: Trace State Park plans a fall festival from 4 to 7 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 24, with entrance fees waived for the event, according to Mississippi State Parks.
The festival will include trick-or-treating, campsite decorating, games and hayrides. Longview Baptist Church is presenting and operating the event in partnership with the park.
For more information, the organizer’s event notice lists 662-489-2958.
